verdict.rationale: xAI's public pricing docs publish a Text API Pricing table with input, cached-input and output prices per 1M tokens for each model, including grok-4.7, with no sales contact. The long-context billing rule is stated, and per-model pages and GET /v1/models also expose pricing. Signup is self-serve. Missing for 10: per-token or unit pricing for the non-text models (image, video, voice) is not evidenced as covering every current model, and there is no independent corroboration of the public pricing page.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every current model without talking to sales

citations.quote: requests whose prompt reaches the listed token threshold are billed at the higher rate for all tokens in the request
GET /v1/models — List all models available to the authenticating API key, including model names (ID), creation times, and pricing
